title: Grusch assigned to the UAP Task Force
summary: David Grusch tells of Grusch assigned to the UAP Task Force, about 2019 at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: David Grusch as NRO liaison to the UAP Task Force

plain: David Grusch, a former intelligence officer, told the podcast host Jesse Michels in 2023 that he was brought into the UAP Task Force, a Pentagon group set up to study UAP, the official term for UFOs, with its director routing the request through an operations centre. A physicist named Eric Davis later said on the same show that Grusch was the liaison from the NRO, the agency that runs US spy satellites, taking direction from the task force's head, Jay Stratton, and he dates it to 2020 and 2021 rather than 2019. It matters because it puts Grusch inside the government's own UFO effort.
